Author: AlexFlipnote
Name: The Holiest Fluffiness
Punchline: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Description: A tweak plugin born for the free company 'The Holiest Fluffiness', now open for all to enjoy.
Changelog:
Clicking the FPS entry on the server info bar can now toggle the FPS limit instead of opening the chart. Pick the behaviour with "On click" under Client > FPS. A toast confirms the change, like "60 FPS (Locked)" or "Unlocked".

New "Limit FPS when AFK" option with its own cap from 1 to 60, applied while you are /afk. It sits next to "Limit FPS when unfocused", and when both apply the lower one wins. Turn off the game's own AFK limit for it to take effect.

Server info bar tooltips (ping, FPS and nearby players) now update while you hover them instead of staying stale until the cursor leaves. The FPS tooltip also shows the cap actually in effect.
